questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will not be correct?

+ and ÷

I. 27 ÷ 3 - 18 × 3 + 9 = 24

II. 12 ÷ 8 × 12 + 16 - 7 = 19
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation I: 27 ÷ 3 - 18 × 3 + 9 = 24.

Now, if '+ and ÷' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 27 + 3 - __**18 × 3 ÷ 9**__ = 24

⇒ __**27 + 3**__ - 6 = 24

⇒ __30** - 6**__ = 24

= 24 = 24.

LHS = RHS.

Given equation II: 12 ÷ 8 × 12 + 16 - 7 = 19.

Now, if '+ and ÷' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 12 + __**8 × 12 ÷ 16**__ - 7 = 19

⇒ __**12 + **____**6**__ - 7 = 19

⇒ __18** - 7**__ = 19

= **11** ≠ 19

LHS ≠ RHS.

Here, Equation II are the incorrect after interchanging the given symbol.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(18, 9, 36)

(36, 18, 72)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **1st number + (2nd number × 2) = 3rd number**.

Now,

For, (18, 9, 36)

⇒ 18 + (9 × 2)

⇒ 18 + 18 = 36.

For, (36, 18, 72)

⇒ 36 + (18 × 2)

⇒ 36 + 36 = 72.

Similarly for, **(32, 16, 64)**

**⇒ 32 + (16 × 2)**

**⇒ 32 + 32 = 64.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question: If 27 A 11 A 8 = 8 and 48 A 37 A 2 = 9, then 56 A 5 A 3 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Consider A as '-'.

Now,

For, 27 A 11 A 8 = 8

⇒ 27 - 11 - 8 = 8.

For, 48 A 37 A 2 = 9

⇒ 48 - 37 - 2 = 9.

Similarly, for 56 A 5 A 3 = ?

⇒ 56 - 5 - 3 = 48.

Hence, the correct answer is **"48"**.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All cherry are pink.

II. Some blue are pink.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some blue are not cherry.

II. All pink are cherry.

III. Some pink are cherry.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

I. All cherry are pink.

II. Some blue are pink.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ebae17560ca091fbd9162b933374e0c53ff5b24ef01f6e31e2f4d4f48d816c4.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some blue are not cherry - False (No definite negative conclusions will be true in a positive statement).

II. All pink are cherry - False (Some pink are cherry is definitely true, but All pink are cherry can be possible only).

III. Some pink are cherry - True (All Cherry are Pink so some pink is cherry is definitely true).

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question: Three of the four group of words are alike in some manner. Select the odd group of words.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option 1) (Sailor, Doctor, Painter) → These all are professions or occupations.

Option 2) (Engineer, Servant, Grocer) → These all are professions or occupations.

**Option 3) (Factory, Garage, Casino) → These all are places where certain activities take place. A factory is a place where goods are manufactured, a garage is a place where cars are repaired or serviced, and a casino is a place where gambling takes place.**

Option 4) (Mechanic, Astronomer, Warrior) → These all are professions or occupations.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
